text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A brand new Bakushin—Supernova Super 
Bakushin! I will never give up first 
place...! Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!! Bakushin O-chan...!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: “But... still!! I... I want to, too...!!”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is North Flight!! Paying no 
heed to the Senior Class veterans! She 
demonstrated her brilliant talent to the 
fullest!”
(Uwoooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! North Flight won! Even with 
last year's winner Flower, Zephyr aiming 
for a third division title... and Bakushin 
O in the race, too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“Still... don't they have a grim look on 
their face? I wonder what's wrong...?”

The venue is buzzing over North Flight's 
victory. However, the girl herself—

âShe was staring at Sakura Bakushin O, 
whom she was supposed to have defeated.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Gnnnghhh!! Flight-san... you're truly 
amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
“—However, this has shown me clearly. I 
will not lose again.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"If we combine control, Bakushin, and even 
more speed... it's infinite!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Model speed! A model race! The fastest one 
of all is ME!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan is... as expected, so very 
stylish!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You are speed itself...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(I am the one who won. But... The one who 
truly looked at home with speed was you.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(I want to polish my raw materials even 
more... and clash against you once more.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Once I've made this outfit truly my 
own... I want to win again—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"A heart-pounding, fiery gaze!! From 
where...—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ! Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Hehehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha!! That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall live up to your expectations. As 
class representative!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Bakushin O-chan is looking at me. Almost 
as if she's about to catch me.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't run away. Next time, I'll be 
there again—right ahead of you!"
